name: Demo hospital (made up)
note: Made-up building, people and devices for the prototype. Not a real hospital.

scenarios.name: Kitchen fire, ground floor
scenarios.note: Fire starts in the kitchen at the east end. Smoke moves west along the north corridor and towards Stair B.

scenarios.name: Store room fire beside the ICU, floor 1
scenarios.note: Fire in the store room next to the lift and the ICU. Ventilated patients need staff, the lift lobby is close to the fire.

scenarios.name: Fast smoke from Store Room 2, floor 2
scenarios.note: Fast smoke on the theatre floor; the south corridor fills first.

scenarios.name: Fire in the Entrance Hall
scenarios.note: The main entrance, the exit most visitors know, is lost. Shows what happens when people do not follow guidance.

scenarios.name: Evacuation drill (no hazard)
scenarios.note: Alarm at the start, no fire. Used for the drill check.

scenarios.name: Drill with the Main Entrance closed
scenarios.note: Same drill with the main entrance out of use. Used as the second (hold-out) drill.
